Container.Name: NuvioExporter
Container.Overview: Move Nuvio collection setups into Fusion widget JSON or Remux smart collections. Preview catalog mappings, update repeat imports without duplicates and request a Remux library refresh. Mixed catalogs and separate genre filters use a persistent compatibility addon. Preserve the appdata mapping and keep this container running; no account login or media mounts required. For trusted networks only: the app has no authentication and exported addon URLs may contain private tokens.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Open http://your-unraid-ip:7088. Change only the host port if it is already used. Keep access on your trusted network.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private compatibility profiles. Preserve this directory across updates and keep backups private.
